messages.subject: Welcome to the grid, {alias}
messages.body:
{alias},

Your account on DarkNode is live. A few things before you get ideas:

- Everything we trade in here is simulation work. Training ranges, recovery jobs, audits. Clients hand you a sandbox, you fix what is broken inside it.
- Your Dashboard shows where you stand. Finance shows where your money went.
- The Terminal understands plain commands. Type 'help'.

The contract board is online. Open Contracts, pick something at your level and read the brief before you accept. Three mistakes and the client walks.

- sysop

messages.subject: About that old rig
messages.body:
Hey {alias},

Heard you finally got that fossil to boot. Do not push it too hard, the cooling is mostly dust.

My shop is on your desktop now: open Marketplace. Start cheap. A tower cooler or a memory kit does more for you than it sounds.

- Mara

messages.subject: First job done
messages.body:
{alias},

Your first contract cleared. The client paid, nobody complained, and your name is on the board now.

A clean job with no mistakes pays a bonus. Jobs from anonymous clients pay more and raise your heat. Choose accordingly.

- sysop

messages.subject: You are learning
messages.body:
{alias},

Level 2. Not much, but everybody on this board started exactly there.

Keep reading the files in /docs. The people who last in this trade are the ones who read the boring parts.

- sysop

messages.subject: New rank: Amateur
messages.body:
{alias},

You are no longer a beginner. Your name shows up in the member list now instead of the guest list.

Do not let it go to your head.

- sysop

messages.subject: New rank: Professional
messages.body:
{alias},

Professional. Clients will start asking for you by name. That is good for business and bad for sleep.

- sysop

messages.subject: New rank: Expert
messages.body:
{alias},

Expert. There are maybe forty of you on the whole board. Spend it wisely.

- sysop

messages.subject: New rank: Specialist
messages.body:
{alias},

Specialist. People are building careers on notes you wrote in an afternoon.

- sysop

messages.subject: New rank: Legend
messages.body:
{alias},

I remember when you could not find the help command.

Legend. There is nothing left for me to teach you.

- sysop

messages.subject: New stock for you
messages.body:
{alias},

You are getting good enough that the mid-range parts are worth your money. Have a look at the tier 2 shelf.

And spend your skill points. The Skills app shows what each one does. Unspent points are just a number.

- Mara

messages.subject: You could put a name on the door
messages.body:
{alias},

You are turning work away. That is the moment most people on this board register a company.

Open Organization. It costs a registration fee, and after that you can rent desks and hire people. Staff either bring in money on their own or back you up on your contracts.

People cost money every day whether or not they earn it. Watch the daily report.

- sysop

messages.subject: Registration confirmed
messages.body:
To {alias},

Your company is now registered.

You currently operate from a home office with one desk. Candidates apply every business day; see the Employees application. Rent and salaries are charged at the end of each business day.

Grid Commerce Office

messages.subject: Stop renting your tools
messages.body:
{alias},

You are good enough to build your own methods now. Open Research.

A project costs money up front and takes time; a faster machine or a GPU shortens it. What you finish stays with you for good, and some of it can be turned into software you sell.

- sysop

messages.subject: You finished a job. Now get serious
messages.body:
{alias},

One clean contract. Good. Now stop working with your hands tied.

Buy one part from Mara, spend a skill point, and do three contracts in all. Your objectives are on screen whenever you are away from the computer.

- sysop

messages.subject: You are turning clients away
messages.body:
{alias},

You have the kit and the habits. What you do not have is a name clients can put on an invoice.

Reach level 3, register a company, and finish a research project so you own at least one method nobody else has.

- sysop

messages.subject: A company of one
messages.body:
{alias},

Congratulations on the paperwork. Now get out of your bedroom.

Rent real desks and hire two people. Once you have an office, use the door in your apartment to go there. It is good for them to see you.

- Mara

messages.subject: Stop selling hours
messages.body:
{alias},

You have people now, so use them. Put someone on Research and someone on Product Development.

Three finished projects, one product on the market, company level 2. Clients pay for your time; customers pay for something you built once.

- sysop

messages.subject: They are calling you 'the tech people'
messages.body:
{alias},

The noodle shop asked me if you were hiring. I said probably.

Five staff, two products, company level 4, and get yourself to level 10. You will need a bigger office first.

- Mara

messages.subject: The last stretch
messages.body:
{alias},

There is one more step and you know what it is.

Company level 8. The Tower Suite. Ten people, four products, level 20. After that there is nothing left for me to send you.

- sysop

messages.subject: Look at what you built
messages.body:
{alias},

I ran this board for a long time and watched a lot of people start in one room.

You are the one who finished.

The board is yours if you want it. Keep playing as long as you like.

- sysop
